remarks: Investors, Tradespeople and Flippers take note! Don't miss this exceptional opportunity for a fix-and-flip or potential expansion into a two-family residence (zoning is multi-family). A beautifully preserved charmer with loads of potential. Detached 2-car garage and spacious backyard. Located in the highly sought after and rapidly enhancing Cove neighborhood - an ideal location for coastal living and recreation. This home is just a 5-minute walk to enormously popular Cove Island Beach and Park. Features include beautiful original hardwood floors, a striking stone facade, all replacement windows, and a nearly-new furnace. With solid bones and tons of potential, this home is a rare value in one of Stamford's highly desirable areas. Half mile to Cove Island beach; 1 mile to I-95; 1 mile to Cummings Park; 2.0 miles to downtown; 2.8 miles to the train station. Don't miss this rare opportunity to create your dream home.
